cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: There Is a Process
cards.instruction: Treat every favor, feeling, and urgent need as a request requiring terms, documentation, review, and approval.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Before I reassure you about the wedding, what precisely am I guaranteeing?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Weather, marriage, or catering? They have different approval routes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One-time or renewable reassurance? I'll amend the request.
